absence_alert_settings_some_rule.name: absence_alert_settings_some_rule
absence_alert_settings_some_rule.value: not "absence_alert_settings"."enabled" or "absence_alert_settings"."consecutive_days" is not null or "absence_alert_settings"."term_days" is not null

fee_concessions_amount_range.name: fee_concessions_amount_range
fee_concessions_amount_range.value: "fee_concessions"."amount_pesewas" is null or ("fee_concessions"."amount_pesewas" between 1 and 1000000000 and "fee_concessions"."fee_item_id" is not null)

guardians_contact.name: guardians_contact
guardians_contact.value: "guardians"."phone" is not null or "guardians"."email" is not null

ledger_entries_amount_sign.name: ledger_entries_amount_sign
ledger_entries_amount_sign.value:
("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'charge' and "ledger_entries"."amount_pesewas" > 0)
        or ("ledger_entries"."kind" in ('payment', 'discount') and "ledger_entries"."amount_pesewas" < 0)
        or ("ledger_entries"."kind" in ('adjustment', 'opening_balance', 'reversal') and "ledger_entries"."amount_pesewas" <> 0)

mobile_money_callbacks_lengths.name: mobile_money_callbacks_lengths
mobile_money_callbacks_lengths.value:
char_length("mobile_money_callbacks"."provider") between 1 and 40
        and ("mobile_money_callbacks"."provider_reference" is null or char_length("mobile_money_callbacks"."provider_reference") between 1 and 120)
        and char_length("mobile_money_callbacks"."body_sha256") = 64
        and ("mobile_money_callbacks"."result" is null or char_length("mobile_money_callbacks"."result") between 1 and 40)

mobile_money_callbacks_ref.name: mobile_money_callbacks_ref
mobile_money_callbacks_ref.value: "mobile_money_callbacks"."request_id" is not null or "mobile_money_callbacks"."provider_reference" is not null

mobile_money_requests_review.name: mobile_money_requests_review
mobile_money_requests_review.value:
("mobile_money_requests"."reviewed_at" is null) = ("mobile_money_requests"."review_note" is null)
        and ("mobile_money_requests"."reviewed_at" is null or "mobile_money_requests"."status" = 'needs_review')
        and ("mobile_money_requests"."review_note" is null or char_length("mobile_money_requests"."review_note") between 3 and 200)

mobile_money_requests_lengths.name: mobile_money_requests_lengths
mobile_money_requests_lengths.value:
char_length("mobile_money_requests"."provider") between 1 and 40
        and ("mobile_money_requests"."provider_reference" is null or char_length("mobile_money_requests"."provider_reference") between 1 and 120)
        and ("mobile_money_requests"."transaction_id" is null or char_length("mobile_money_requests"."transaction_id") between 1 and 60)
        and ("mobile_money_requests"."status_reason" is null or char_length("mobile_money_requests"."status_reason") between 1 and 200)

payments_reference_length.name: payments_reference_length
payments_reference_length.value: "payments"."reference" is null or char_length("payments"."reference") between 1 and 60

payments_payer_length.name: payments_payer_length
payments_payer_length.value: "payments"."payer_name" is null or char_length("payments"."payer_name") between 1 and 120

report_cards_published_complete.name: report_cards_published_complete
report_cards_published_complete.value: ("report_cards"."status" = 'published') = ("report_cards"."snapshot" is not null and "report_cards"."published_at" is not null)

report_cards_attendance.name: report_cards_attendance
report_cards_attendance.value: ("report_cards"."days_open" is null or "report_cards"."days_open" between 0 and 366) and ("report_cards"."days_present" is null or ("report_cards"."days_present" >= 0 and ("report_cards"."days_open" is null or "report_cards"."days_present" <= "report_cards"."days_open")))

students_names_length.name: students_names_length
students_names_length.value: char_length("students"."first_name") between 1 and 60 and char_length("students"."last_name") between 1 and 60
